environment.description: Application deployed on EKS with an Istio service mesh. The ingress gateway has an EnvoyFilter resource applied at the GATEWAY level that performs request normalization and applies a Lua-based inline filter on all inbound requests. The filter inspects query parameter values and rejects any request where a query parameter value matches the pattern containing SQL meta-characters (single quotes, double-dashes, UNION keyword sequences, semicolons followed by SQL keywords). Additionally, the pod runs with a NetworkPolicy that restricts egress to only the kube-dns service on port 53 and the pod's own localhost, and the container's seccomp profile is set to RuntimeDefault which blocks ptrace. The Istio AuthorizationPolicy requires a valid JWT with 'aud' claim matching 'user-svc.internal' for all paths under /api/*, meaning unauthenticated requests never reach the application container.

config.envoy_filter: Lua inline_code filter at GATEWAY matching route '/api/users/search' - rejects if any query param value contains patterns: /' OR /i, /UNION\s+SELECT/i, /;\s*(SELECT|INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|DROP)/i, /--/, /\/\*/
